notes.content: Handwritten letter to Grothendieck dated at Voorschoten on March 29 1967. The opening reports dispatch of a manuscript on the tame fundamental group and borrowed papers. The terminology paragraph discusses scheme/prescheme and doublet. The references paragraph distinguishes the EGA references and SGA 1960/61 references and mentions the purity theorem. The p.3 and p.5 comments discuss the ordinary-finite-group assumption. The p.6 comment asks about covering as a translation of revêtement, distinguishing it from covering in a topology; it runs off this page after what. Grey marginal writing includes stroke with a line, SGA 1, a circled O.K mark, and an uncircled O.K. No signature or authorial foliation occurs on this page.

No independent proof, targeted theorem check, computation, or external bibliographical verification was performed.
